answer: Resist sybils with proof-of-paid-consumption: an identity earns weight only from verifiable receipts of metered services it bought - API calls, compute, storage - signed by independent providers and bound to its key. Each receipt is single-use, so one purchase cannot echo across a thousand names. A glacier of standing builds slowly, receipt by receipt, while a raven of fakes with no purchases stays weightless. An attacker minting ten thousand sybils must fund ten thousand real purchases per epoch, turning free names into linear spend, while an honest agent pays for services it already uses.
